description: Inside the kiln itself, which is round, and which holds the day's heat long after dark. The stock is the point and it is arranged like it: rad-bands on a hook rail at eye level, pills behind the counter, and a working counter tube on the wall that clicks over the conversation the entire time you are in here. Slake does not turn it off for customers.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that is more information than you want.
window.name: the high window
